packageRules.description: Pin every Docker base image by digest and keep the digests fresh in bulk. This is the 'shared pin' half of the layer-cache fix (#145): a base image moving becomes a deliberate, reviewable PR instead of an implicit tag drift that re-pulls the whole image on the Pi. Covers debian:bookworm-slim across containers/*/Dockerfile and the internal coordinator-vio-*-base images once app Dockerfiles consume them by digest.
Group the fleet base-image digest bumps into one PR so a debian point-release sweeps every image together.
